title: Operations Supervisor
description: Official Amazon operations role in Jeddah, listed under Afaq - Warehouse Branch. The role oversees shift management across fulfillment, sortation, or delivery-station operations, drives safety, trains associates, keeps orders on quality and safety targets, shares shift-level operational updates, adjusts labor allocation to match plans, coordinates with support teams on readiness and training, and helps solve logistics and supply-chain challenges through data analysis and process improvement.
